 If Abhishek, Ishan don”t get picked for ODIs, we”re not doing justice to their talent: Yuvraj Singh
 PTI 
 30 October, 2026 07:45 pm IST 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin 
 Follow Us : 
 Text Size:
 A- 
 A+ 
 -->
 Mumbai, Oct 30 (PTI) Former India all-rounder Yuvraj Singh believes that not regularly picking players like Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the ODI squad does not do “justice” to their immense talent.
 “I would love to see him (Abhishek) in the ODIs, to be honest, and I have said this before that if we are not picking guys like Ishan Kishan, Abhishek and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in 50-over cricket, then somewhere down the line we are not doing justice to their talent,” Yuvraj told PTI on the sidelines of the launch event of Protocol 32.
 It must be mentioned that Yuvraj has been Abhishek’s longtime mentor.
 Show Full Article
 Yuvraj, however, said he understands the presence of senior players in the side makes it a bit difficult for young players to get a look-in.
 “I understand we have some great players and it is hard to make a spot for them. I think the way they (young batters) are performing, hopefully, they should be in the squad soon. Whatever he (Abhishek) has achieved is because of his hard work, and credit goes to him,” he added. PTI PSJ KHS UNG
